This map shows the postings in the AEA Job Openings for Economists (JOE) listings. Blue dots are academic jobs and orange dots are nonacademic jobs. Click a dot to see that city's postings, each linked to its JOE listing. You can also [open the map in its own window](joe-map/index.html).
